name: Acme Cloud — RAG Corpus
note: Acme Cloud support docs for RAG evaluation.

chunks.title: Pro plan pricing
chunks.text: The Acme Cloud Pro plan costs $49 per month, billed monthly, and includes 5 user seats. Prices exclude applicable taxes.

chunks.title: Team plan pricing
chunks.text: The Acme Cloud Team plan costs $99 per month and includes 15 user seats. Annual billing saves 20%.

chunks.title: Enterprise plan
chunks.text: The Enterprise plan is custom-priced and adds SSO, audit logs, and a dedicated success manager. Contact sales for a quote.

chunks.title: Adding and removing seats
chunks.text: Seats are managed in Settings > Billing > Seats. The Pro plan is capped at 5 seats; to exceed that, upgrade to Team (up to 15) or Enterprise. There is no unlimited-seats option.

chunks.title: Refund policy
chunks.text: Refunds are issued within 30 days of the original purchase date. After 30 days, purchases are non-refundable. There are no exceptions to the 30-day window.

chunks.title: Cancellation and downgrade
chunks.text: You may cancel or downgrade at any time from Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; no partial-month refunds are given for cancellation.

chunks.title: Password reset
chunks.text: To reset your password, open the Login page, click Forgot Password, enter your account email, and follow the secure link. The reset link expires after 60 minutes.

chunks.title: Two-factor authentication
chunks.text: Two-factor authentication (2FA) can be enabled in Settings > Security. Acme Cloud supports authenticator apps (TOTP) and SMS codes. Recovery codes are issued when 2FA is turned on.

chunks.title: Accepted payment methods
chunks.text: Acme Cloud accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. We do not accept cryptocurrency, wire transfer, or cheque.

chunks.title: Account lockout
chunks.text: After 5 failed login attempts an account is locked for 30 minutes. Wait 30 minutes or contact support for an immediate unlock after identity verification.

chunks.title: Data export
chunks.text: Export your account data from Settings > Data > Export. Exports are delivered as a ZIP to the account owner's email and can take up to 1 hour for large accounts.

chunks.title: Discount policy
chunks.text: Discounts are only available through published promotions and the 20% annual-billing saving. Support cannot generate ad-hoc discount codes on request.
